title: Workspace setup review
description: The reviewer's verdict on a composed setup set, and what a next attempt must satisfy when it is unacceptable. Validity only: whether another attempt runs is decided by deterministic code from this verdict and the attempt count, so there is no 'retry' value here and no SKU, product or price.

isAcceptable.description: True when every requested slot is answered within the stated ceiling by genuinely different setups.

issues.description: One entry per ground, each an instruction the next attempt can reinterpret. Empty when acceptable.

summary.description: One line, when there is one.

requiredCorrectionDescription.description: What was not satisfied, in terms the rephraser can reinterpret. Never a replacement product.
